tagline: 美能达旁轴相机，1965 年发布
description: 美能达于1965年推出的旁轴相机。配备Rokkor-QF 1:1.8 f=40mm with 6 elements。快门速度Electromagnetic leaf shutter allowing speed/aperture combinations in a range from f1.8 1/16 sec. to f16 1/512 sec.。使用35mm with speeds 25 ASA to 400 ASA。

specs.快门: Electromagnetic leaf shutter allowing speed/aperture combinations in a range from f1.8 1/16 sec. to f16 1/512 sec.
specs.闪光灯: flash gun connectable on hot shoe, X/M flash synchronization of shutter at speed 1/25 sec., aperture coupled to distance control
specs.英文简介: The Minolta Electro Shot was Minolta's first rangefinder camera with CdS meter controlled exposure.
